translations.web: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.
translations.bsb: He who pursues righteousness and loving devotion finds life, righteousness, and honor.
translations.kjv: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.
